alt: A point update on a Fenwick tree. One element gains a value. The update starts at that position and adds the change to tree[i], then adds the lowest set bit of i to i and repeats until i passes the end. Each tree entry it visits covers a block that contains the changed element.

steps.caption: Position 3 is about to go up by 5, from 1 to 6. Every tree entry whose block contains position 3 must go up by 5 too. The update finds them by starting at i and adding the lowest set bit.
i is 3 (00011). tree[3] covers just position 3, so it goes from 1 to 6. Add the lowest set bit, 1, to reach i = 4 (00100).
i is 4 (00100). tree[4] covers positions 1 to 4, which include position 3, so it goes from 10 to 15. Add the lowest set bit, 4, to reach i = 8 (01000).
i is 8 (01000). tree[8] covers positions 1 to 8, which include position 3, so it goes from 21 to 26. Add the lowest set bit, 8, to reach i = 16 (10000), which is past 8.
i is past 8, so the update stops after 3 entries. Every block that contained position 3 now includes the change, and the 8 elements total 26.
Position 1 is about to go up by 5, from 3 to 8. Every tree entry whose block contains position 1 must go up by 5 too. The update finds them by starting at i and adding the lowest set bit.
i is 1 (00001). tree[1] covers just position 1, so it goes from 3 to 8. Add the lowest set bit, 1, to reach i = 2 (00010).
i is 2 (00010). tree[2] covers positions 1 to 2, which include position 1, so it goes from 5 to 10. Add the lowest set bit, 2, to reach i = 4 (00100).
i is 4 (00100). tree[4] covers positions 1 to 4, which include position 1, so it goes from 10 to 15. Add the lowest set bit, 4, to reach i = 8 (01000).
i is 8 (01000). tree[8] covers positions 1 to 8, which include position 1, so it goes from 21 to 26. Add the lowest set bit, 8, to reach i = 16 (10000), which is past 8.
i is past 8, so the update stops after 4 entries. Every block that contained position 1 now includes the change, and the 8 elements total 26.
Position 8 is about to go up by 5, from 3 to 8. Every tree entry whose block contains position 8 must go up by 5 too. The update finds them by starting at i and adding the lowest set bit.
i is 8 (01000). tree[8] covers positions 1 to 8, which include position 8, so it goes from 21 to 26. Add the lowest set bit, 8, to reach i = 16 (10000), which is past 8.
i is past 8, so the update stops after 1 entry. Every block that contained position 8 now includes the change, and the 8 elements total 26.
